classification_policy.experimental: The three saved alternative calibration runs surface_probe/adaptive_probe/coacd and their explicit mesh outputs; current production or historical overlap is retained.
classification_policy.historical: Explicit path identity in scanned saved resource_fingerprints or archived legacy scene XML; recorded SHA compared with current bytes. Does not claim standalone glTF playback depends on source OBJ files.
classification_policy.overlap: memberships and references retain every positive class; primary_category is only a disjoint reporting partition. unknown applies only when no positive class exists.
classification_policy.production: Positive reference from current runtime manifests/templates, or an accepted cache read by the current official offline generation script. Not proof that every task/seed executes every manifest entry; roles separate runtime from offline caches.
classification_policy.reference_locations: location_hint is a human-readable section/key, XML attribute or nested-record locator; mapping keys may contain unescaped slashes, so it is not uniformly an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer.
classification_policy.unknown: Not established as any of the three protected use classes in the bounded scan. Preserve any independently known auxiliary role; not a claim of total ignorance, nonuse, obsolescence or deletion permission.

historical_scan.hdf5_scope: Root provenance JSON dataset only; root attribute names inventoried, trajectory arrays not decoded. No direct calibrated resource_fingerprints found in these datasets; scene JSON carries restore references.

limitations: Static production declarations are a conservative protected set, not a full execution trace.
External historical scans describe the configured local root and one discovered ZIP at inventory time, not all historical data anywhere.
A lack of historical-only files does not imply lack of historical dependencies; overlaps remain explicit.
Accepted generator caches are production-chain dependencies but not runtime simulation inputs.
All original files are retained, including clearly experimental and unknown files.

methods.auxiliary_records: parts.json parts and racks.json models match their current main-manifest sections, but that does not establish an active consumer or historical use of the auxiliary record files themselves. Keep those two records unknown with an explicit auxiliary role.
methods.experiments: Read only the three named experimental records and their explicit meshes/parts/models mappings. Do not classify other files by similar filename or count differences.
methods.historical: Scan all 25 legacy XMLs with original scene base context; recursively inspect resource_fingerprints in loose/archived JSON, including JSON-encoded object strings. Rebase objects/... and @assets/objects/... identities to local assets/objects, retain recorded-vs-current hash mismatches. Inspect root provenance JSON datasets of loose and archived HDF5 files read-only, without loading trajectory arrays.
methods.inventory: Recursively enumerate regular files in the three scope roots, sort repository-relative paths, SHA-256 complete bytes; output one row for every file.
methods.offline_cache: For each current props geometry key inspect key/geometry.json, require the generator reuse conditions (surface_partition_v1, <=64 meshes, finite max surface error), and exact JSON equality with the production geometry record. Mark as offline cache, not runtime input.
methods.production: Collision meshes/parts/models resolve against calibrated_collision; marker mesh paths resolve against assets/objects. Props meshes are selected through every current variants[].geometry. Include three runtime manifest files. Parse active template resource declarations using compiler asset-root mapping and the 11 replacement model XML files.

scope.excluded: No unconfigured data roots, remote archives, git history, deleted files, compiled checkpoints, or exhaustive dynamic task/seed execution. No inference from file age or geometry-hash filename.
scope.mode: management-only; retain every original path and byte
scope.path_convention: Repository-relative POSIX paths for local evidence and files. Historical external evidence uses external_root + relative_path or archive_relative_path/archive_member.

cache_key_smoke.method: Read-only import of the current calibrate_imported_props.visual_mesh; recompute SHA256(vertices bytes + faces bytes)[:16] for every current task model. No main(), generate(), export or write invoked.

verification.classification_checks: Persisted JSON consumed; unique complete file coverage, disjoint primary totals, category overlap, evidence hashes and foreign keys verified. Runtime, offline cache, experimental, historical overlap and unknown auxiliary lookups exercised.
verification.scope: Management-data verification and read-only cache-key smoke, not simulation dynamics regression.
